summary: Backend-only testing of LIVO vision endpoints via external ingress URL (https://livo-access-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api). Generated real feature-rich JPEG images per /app/image_testing.md: a mathematically-correct thermal receipt, a mismatched receipt (subtotal 400 + tax 20 vs total 500), a non-bill abstract photo, INR-note mockups (500/500/100/50/20), a non-cash mug/desk photo, and empty payloads. Ran 9 pytest cases against Gemini gemini-3.1-pro-preview via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. All 9 passed (25.84s).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _clean_base64 raises HTTPException(400) for empty image (good). For an all-whitespace string it would pass through as empty after strip; consider re-checking after strip.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan handler. Non-blocking.

_verify_bill returns total=expected_total when incoming total is 0, meaning verified may become True even if the model failed to read the total. Acceptable fallback but consider raising an issue when total is missing.
Persistence to Mongo swallows all exceptions with a generic warning; consider logging exception detail for debuggability.
seed_data_creation: None. Images are generated in-memory each test run; two Mongo collections (bill_scans, cash_scans) receive scan documents as a side-effect of the endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_livo_vision.py as regression suite. image_factory.py renders realistic receipts (with GST layout) and INR-note-styled mockups. BASE_URL is auto-detected from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env; falls back to localhost:8001. Vision calls take ~5-15s each so use TIMEOUT=180. Frontend (camera/mic/TTS) is browser-only and out of scope here.
rca of the issue: N/A - all endpoints behave correctly. Correct-math receipt -> verified=true / BILL VERIFIED / issues=[]. Wrong-math receipt (400+20 vs 500) -> verified=false / CHECK BILL / issues[] populated. Non-bill photo returns well-formed JSON with empty items. Empty image returns 400. Cash endpoint returns detected flag, denomination-desc-sorted notes, and total = sum(denom*count); no-cash image returns detected=false with empty notes. No ObjectId leakage in responses.
